newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,545.8 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 3,545.8 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 89.0 million Swiss francs to 3.55 billion in the reporting period ended March 10.
Statement of March 10 in millions of Swiss francs:
Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window fell by 20.1 million francs to 2.6 million in the reporting period.
Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 897.5 million francs to 2,531.4 million.
An SNB spokesman demand was greater, but it was nothing dramatic and that the central bank was supplying ample liquidity in response to this demand.
"We are accomodating the demand generously," the SNB spokesman said. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
